## 4. Ex gratia lumpsum compensation to families of Central Government Civilian employees who die in harness  
[ Swamy's CCS (Extraordinary Pension) Rules]  
The families of Central Government Civilian employees who die in harness in the performance of their bona fide official duties under various circumstances, shall be paid the following ex gratia lumpsum compensation.  
| (a) | Death occurring due to accidents in the course of performance of duties | < 25 lakhs |
